canonical_title: People Involved in a Training Program and How They Help
aliases: Briefing all relevant people involved in the training program
People who help plan, deliver and follow up training

one_line_answer.text: Very few training programs are single handedly run by one person.

cites.quote: Very few training programs are single handedly run by one person.

bangla_explanation: একজন trainer একা কোনো training program চালাতে পারে না — সামনে ও পেছনে অনেক লোক কাজ করে।
Planning, delivering আর following up — আগে, চলাকালীন ও পরে নানা কাজে এদের সাহায্য লাগে।
তাই সবাইকে briefing দিন: কে কী কাজে সাহায্য করবে, আগেই ঠিক করুন।
আপনার প্রতিষ্ঠানে পদের নাম আলাদা হতে পারে, কিছু কাজ প্রযোজ্য নাও হতে পারে।

example.en: In a TTC welding course, the admin officer books the room. A technician sets up the projector.
example.bn: Welding কোর্সে admin officer room booking করেন, technician projector set up করেন, finance staff guest speaker-এর payment দেন।

list_answer.title: People who might help with a training program, and how they help
list_answer.title_bn: Training program-এ যারা সাহায্য করে এবং কীভাবে

items.text: Administrative staff: administration details, enrolments, enquiries, training records, room bookings.

cites.quote: recording administration details before, during and after;
handling general enquiries and correspondence for training;

items.text: Finance staffs: costing the programs, financial records, payments and reimbursements.
Typist/word processor operators: producing handouts and exercises, photocopying materials.
Technicians and computer experts: advise on, set up and operate technical equipment; fix problems.

cites.quote: Technicians and computer experts help with
advising on how to use technical equipment;
setting up any technical equipment before the training sessions;
attending to problems or maintenance during the program.

items.text: Physical resources and maintenance staff: emergency situations and providing consumables.

cites.quote: handling emergency situations (eg air conditioning malfunction, lost keys);

items.text: Consultants: planning, costing, record keeping systems, evaluating your training skills.
Assessors: clarify outcomes and criteria, suggest assessment methods, prepare trainees, discuss feedback.

cites.quote: clarifying the learning outcomes, assessment criteria and assessment
suggesting assessment methods trainees will nees to be familiar
preparing trainees for the assessment process;
discussing giving trainees feedback about their performance.

items.text: Subject experts and guest speakers: giving demonstrations, presenting specialist information.

cites.quote: Subject experts and guest speakers (internal or external)

items.text: Seniors in training department: approval, costing, planning, evaluating and debriefing.

cites.quote: planning before and evaluating during and after the program;

items.text: Other trainers: running session components, receiving trainee feedback, debriefing after sessions.
Trainees' supervisors, managers or coordinators: training needs, standards, current competencies, practice, feedback.

cites.quote: providing information on company or industry standards;
organising ongoing practice during and after sessions;
giving feedback about trainees' improvement in work tasks;

items.text: Trainees' co-workers: feedback heard from trainees; supporting trainees' learning and practice.

cites.quote: giving you feedback about the program that they have heard from the trainees;
supporting the trainees in their learning and ongoing practice.

items_bn: Administrative staff ভর্তি, খোঁজখবর, training records আর room booking সামলায়।
Finance staffs খরচের হিসাব, financial records আর speakers ও trainees-এর payments দেখে।
Typist handouts ও exercises তৈরি করে, trainer-এর জন্য photocopy করে।
Technicians technical equipment কীভাবে চালাতে হয় বলে, আগে set up করে, চালায় আর সমস্যা হলে ঠিক করে।
Maintenance staff জরুরি অবস্থা (যেমন AC নষ্ট, চাবি হারানো) সামলায় আর consumables দেয়।
Consultants program planning, costing, record keeping systems আর আপনার training skills মূল্যায়নে সাহায্য করে।
Assessors learning outcomes ও assessment criteria স্পষ্ট করে, methods সাজেস্ট করে, trainees-কে প্রস্তুত করে আর feedback নিয়ে আলোচনা করে।
Subject experts ও guest speakers demonstrations দেয় আর specialist information উপস্থাপন করে।
Seniors program-এর approval দেয়, costing, planning, evaluating আর শেষে debriefing করে।
অন্য trainers session-এর কিছু অংশ চালায়, trainees-এর feedback নেয়, শেষে debriefing করে।
Supervisors training needs ও trainees-এর current competencies নির্ধারণ করে, standards জানায়, practice-এর ব্যবস্থা ও feedback দেয়।
সহকর্মীরা trainees-এর কাছে শোনা feedback জানায় আর তাদের learning ও practice-এ সহায়তা করে।

may differ and some tasks may not be relevant.

traps.text: Trainees' supervisors help determine training needs and trainees' current competencies.

short.prompt: Name the people who might help you with a training program. How do they help?
short.modelAnswer:
Very few training programs are run by one person. People who help:
1. Administrative staff: enrolments, records, room bookings.
2. Finance staffs: costing, payments.
3. Typists: handouts, photocopying.
4. Technicians: set up and operate equipment.
5. Maintenance staff: emergencies, consumables.
6. Consultants: planning, costing.
7. Assessors: assessment criteria and methods.
8. Subject experts: demonstrations.
9. Seniors: approval.
10. Other trainers: run components.
11. Supervisors: training needs.
12. Co-workers: support practice.
